retroarch: Multi-system emulation with RetroArch and its Switch 2 cores.
Use ROMs or disc images from your original games. Some cores require BIOS files from your own consoles.
sw2nes: NES emulator with save states, filters and two-player support.
Requires ROMs dumped from your original NES games.
sw2snes: Super Nintendo emulator with rewind, filters and support for special chips.
Requires ROMs dumped from your original Super Nintendo games.
mgba: Game Boy Advance emulator with audio and save support.
Add ROMs from your original games. You can also use the BIOS from your own console.
melonds-switch2: Requires ROMs from your original games and, if requested, the BIOS and firmware from your own DS.
kaizhar: Requires your original games and any files the setup needs from your own console.
toronja: Nintendo 3DS emulator with resolution and screen layout options.
Requires games dumped from your original 3DS copies.
dolphin-nx2: Requires disc images from your original GameCube or Wii games.
cemu-nx2: Wii U emulator adapted for Switch 2.
Requires data from your original Wii U games and any files the format needs from your own console.
eden-on-switch-2: Experimental emulator for original Switch games.
Requires your original games and the relevant keys or firmware from your own console.
sw2ps2: PlayStation 2 emulator with a native interface.
Requires disc images from your original games and the BIOS from your own PlayStation 2.
ouncesx2: ArmSX2 core port for PlayStation 2 emulation.
Requires disc images from your original games and the BIOS from your own PlayStation 2.
ppsspp-nx2-by-david-kalil: Native PPSSPP port with JIT compilation.
Requires images from your original PSP games.
ppsspp-nx2-by-xitrix: PPSSPP port with experimental local multiplayer features.
Requires images from your original PSP games.
vita3k-nx-and-vita3k-nx2: PlayStation Vita emulator adapted for Switch 2.
Requires your original PS Vita games and the official firmware and fonts requested by Vita3K.
gravity-rush-nx2: Vita3K build dedicated to Gravity Rush.
Requires your original copy of Gravity Rush and the compatible data requested by the port.
kaikart: Launcher for Mario Kart Wii and Retro Rewind on Switch 2.
Requires an unmodified PAL disc image from your original Mario Kart Wii disc (RMCP01).
dusklight: Native Twilight Princess port for Switch 2.
Requires data from a supported original GameCube disc you own.
super-smash-bros-melee: Native Melee port with support for 20XX Tournament Edition.
Requires data from your original NTSC 1.02 Super Smash Bros. Melee disc.
skate-3: Requires your original Xbox 360 game data, Title Update 3 and the prepared resources listed by the project.
lost-odyssey-recomp: Native recompilation of the Xbox 360 RPG.
Requires your original Lost Odyssey discs and preparation of the data for all four discs on the microSD card.
sonic-unleashed-recompiled: Experimental Sonic Unleashed recompilation for Switch 2.
Requires data from a supported original Xbox 360 copy of Sonic Unleashed.
donkey-kong-country-2-and-3: Native Donkey Kong Country 2 recompilation for Switch 2.
Requires data from a supported original Super Nintendo copy of Donkey Kong Country 2.
donkey-kong-country-3: Native Donkey Kong Country 3 recompilation for Switch 2.
Requires data from a supported original Super Nintendo copy of Donkey Kong Country 3.
pokemon-platinum: Native Pokémon Platinum port with touch controls.
Requires a ROM dumped from your original Pokémon Platinum cartridge. The port prepares its game data from that ROM.
super-mario-64-ex-alo: Switch 2 build of the sm64ex port.
Requires creating base.zip from the supported original US edition of Super Mario 64.
metroid-zero-mission-nx: Native Metroid: Zero Mission reimplementation with map and settings.
Requires a ROM from a supported original Metroid: Zero Mission cartridge for Game Boy Advance.
sonic-3-a-i-r: Native Sonic 3 A.I.R. port for Switch 2.
Requires the supported original Sonic 3 & Knuckles file in the port's savedata folder.
dr-robotniks-ring-racers: Kart Krew's racing game adapted for Switch 2.
xstarbound: Enhanced Starbound engine adapted for Switch 2.
Requires files from an original Steam copy of Starbound that you own.
openrct2: Open-source RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 engine with touch controls.
Requires files from a supported original copy of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2.
cave-story-nxengine-evo: Native port of the open-source Cave Story engine.
If the engine requests assets, use the original freeware edition of Cave Story.
angry-birds-reloaded: Experimental compatibility layer for Angry Birds Reloaded.
Requires files and libraries from a supported original copy (version 2.2.16218).
scummvm-s2: Classic adventure game engines adapted for Switch 2.
Add data from your original copies of the supported games.
ouncedonut-and-bad-apple: Spinning donut graphics demo for Switch 2.
moonlight-nx2-by-azkali: Remote-play client with audio and hardware video decoding.
Requires a host computer with Sunshine configured.
moonlight-switch-by-xitrix: Remote-play client with controller support and Joy-Con mouse controls.
Requires a host computer with Sunshine configured.
super-moonlight-nx2: Moonlight client for Switch 2 with optional remote access via Tailscale.
Requires Sunshine on your host computer. Remote access may require a Tailscale account.
punktfunk: Requires the matching PunktFunk server on a computer.
chiaki-ng-akira: Requires your own PS4 or PS5 with Remote Play enabled.
green-nx: Requires a supported Xbox account with access to cloud gaming.
switchnow: Unofficial GeForce NOW client for Switch 2.
Requires a GeForce NOW account and access to the service.
chromium-nx: Chromium browser for Switch 2 with touch and keyboard support.
May need an internet connection to fetch initial resources.
kaivideo: Local video player and media client for Switch 2.
Use your own videos or a Jellyfin, Emby or Plex server you have permission to access.
kaiplayer: Local music player with a library, equalizer and playlists.
Add your own music files to the microSD card.
kairadio: Internet radio player with station favorites.
Requires internet access to load Radio Browser and stream stations.
switchfin-nx2: Requires access to your Jellyfin server.
gamepad-media-center-aggregator: Client for Plex, Jellyfin, Emby and other media services.
Requires access to an authorized media server or service.
stremnx2: Requires an internet connection and content sources you have permission to access.
switch2iptv: IPTV player with M3U playlists, a guide and favorites.
Requires your own M3U playlist or credentials for a service you are authorized to use.
sphaira: Alternative homebrew menu with a Switch 2 file manager.
iz2s-cheese: Alternative homebrew store with a Switch 2 NRO.
IZA modules require the corresponding platform. This package contains the standalone NRO.
sw2transfer: Browser-based file manager for the Switch 2 microSD card.
Connect the other device to the same local network to transfer files.
checkpoint: Back up and restore game saves.
Keep a copy of your saves before restoring.
pksm: Save manager for supported Pokémon games.
Use your own saves and keep a backup before editing.
nhse: Save editor for Animal Crossing: New Horizons.
Requires an exported copy of your own save. Keep the original.
nxgallery: Access console screenshots and videos over your local network.
Use a browser on another device on the same network to view or transfer files.
force-internal-speakers: Routes audio to the console's built-in speakers.
grand-theft-auto-vice-city: Vice City reimplementation based on reVC and librw.
Requires the folders from a supported original PC copy of Vice City that you own.
balatro: LÖVE engine build for running Balatro on Switch 2.
Requires extracting files from your original Steam copy of Balatro.
perfect-dark: Native Perfect Dark port for Switch 2.
Requires your original Perfect Dark (USA) ROM with the filename listed by the project.
half-life: Half-Life port based on Xash3D FWGS.
Requires the valve folder from your original Half-Life installation from before the 25th Anniversary Edition.
ouncetato: Requires Brotato.pck from your original Steam copy (supported version 1.2.0.3).
openrac: Native port of the first Ratchet & Clank for Switch 2.
Requires preparing data from your original NTSC-U Ratchet & Clank disc for PlayStation 2.
sd-bench: Measures microSD read and write speed.
The test needs roughly 512 MB free on the card.
ouncemtp: Transfer microSD files over USB using MTP.
Requires a USB data cable and another device with MTP support.
kodi-ns2: Experimental Kodi port for audio and video playback.
Requires the Kodi executable and its resource folder, plus your own media files.
netsurf-switch2: NetSurf browser for Switch 2 with HTTPS support.
pkforge-switch2: Local editor for exported Pokémon save files.
Requires an exported copy of your own save. Keep the original.
jksv-ns2: Game save backup manager for Switch 2.
Keep a copy of your saves before restoring.
torchlight-rekindled: Experimental Torchlight engine port for Switch 2.
Requires data from a supported original PC or Xbox 360 copy of Torchlight.
chocolate-doom: Native port of the Chocolate Doom engine.
Add your original or shareware IWAD and the official default.cfg and chocolate-doom.cfg files.
lego-star-wars-the-complete-saga: Native LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga port.
Requires the files from your original Android 2.0.2.02 copy (build 20202).
need-for-speed-hot-pursuit-2: Native Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit 2 port.
Requires preparing data from your original PAL 1.00 PlayStation 2 disc (SLES-50731).
openblops-nx: Call of Duty: Black Ops engine reimplementation.
Requires preparing files from your original PC installation of Black Ops.
phantasy-star-portable-2-infinity-port: Native Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity recompilation.
Requires files from a supported original PSP copy of Phantasy Star Portable 2 Infinity.
izpsx: Experimental PlayStation emulator based on PCSX-ReARMed with memory card and multiplayer support.
This build is an IZ2S module. Use games dumped from your original PlayStation discs.
fastcars-recomp-nx2: Experimental Switch 2 recompilation of the Xbox 360 release of Grand Theft Auto V.
Setup needs a PC, both original Xbox 360 discs, and Title Update 27.
celeste-classic: Shader-based adaptation of the original PICO-8 game. The current build is silent.
Hardware testing is limited. Check the project repository for build information.
izdoom: Experimental IZ2S port of DOOM with GPU rendering and widescreen support.
Requires IZ2S and data from your original DOOM copy. Console audio is still being tested.
dirt-2: DiRT 2 on Switch 2 as demonstrated by XITRIX.
The project page links to the demonstration. No public build is verified for installation.
jellyfin-by-thzoria-and-yaja: Two legacy Jellyfin clients for a personal media server.
Requires CivHomebrew. Check the runtime version specified by each client author.
ounce-hbmenu: Launcher for Nintendo Switch 2 homebrew apps.
This launcher is part of the homebrew setup. See its project documentation.
brewstore: Homebrew storefront with its own repositories and releases.
The documented setup replaces the launcher. Follow the author’s instructions.
ounceshell: VitaShell-derived file manager for Switch 2 with a built-in FTP server.
It is bundled with the homebrew setup. Consult the project repository for details.
kaidrop: Windows file-transfer client for Switch 2 with console filename and playlist cleanup.
Runs on Windows. See the project page for ways to connect to the console.
kaihen: Reference for the experimental runtime used by various Switch 2 homebrew projects.
Compatibility depends on the runtime version required by each project. Runtime setup is managed outside the store.
ounce-devkit: Homebrew development and porting tools for Switch 2, including libounce and OunceVK.
This toolkit runs on a computer. See the project repository for development documentation.
native-builds: Guide to identifying native Switch 2 builds and understanding when a port needs recompilation.
This is a compatibility guide. For installation requirements, check the individual application.
legacy-packages: Reference for legacy CivHomebrew .civapp and IZ2S .iza packages.
Check which runtime is specified for each version of the application.
useful-gameplay-reports: Guide to sharing performance reports with relevant versions, resolution, and test conditions.
The page explains how to describe visual issues, audio, and stability.
civswitch-serialbridge: Serial bridge project for CivSwitch using ESP32 or Linux-capable hardware.
Requires external hardware and its own setup. Consult the project documentation.
web-file-manager: Plugin for managing files on the microSD card from a browser on the local network.
It is a kaiHEN startup plugin without password protection, intended for trusted networks.
simplestreamer: Experimental plugin that streams Switch 2 video and audio to another device over the network or USB.
Requires a kaiHEN plugin and a receiving device. USB streaming works in handheld mode.
godot-editor-export-templates-for-switch: Godot editor and templates for exporting games and projects to Switch 2.
The editor runs on a computer. See the repository for export setup.
minecraft-rust: Minecraft: Java Edition adapted for Switch 2, with online play, VRR and Joy-Con mouse support.
Setup uses a Windows program. Use a legitimate copy of Minecraft: Java Edition.
